summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature. rich/progress.py: added private _ProgressReader (binary reader advancing a Progress task) and _ProgressContext (starts/stops Progress around the yielded object), module-level open and wrap_file with overloads for 'r'/'rt' and 'rb', and Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods. tests/test_progress.py: 16 new tests before the script-entry block, plus imports. docs/source/progress.rst: "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" subsections. CHANGELOG.md: one Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 1759. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, so the code and tests are unverified. Still to check: typing.ContextManager and contextlib.AbstractContextManager on Python 3.6, and that the listed mypy suppressions match real errors.
